reason: Both identify huge ByteSize strings converting to infinity and leaking raw OverflowError instead of normalized ValidationError.

Both identify include/exclude cleared when a custom serializer is skipped and its fallback runs, so model_dump silently ignores requested filters. Static broken-reference and test-only findings are excluded.
Both identify omitted extra_serializer from GeneralFieldsSerializer GC traversal, hiding Python-reference cycles and leaking them.
Both identify lost definitions-based resolution for callable discriminators over PEP 695 alias definition refs, leaving tags unresolved and raising missing-Tag errors.
Both identify Interval bound truthiness checks silently skipping zero-valued ge/gt/le/lt constraints and accepting invalid values.

Both identify derived alias-validation settings mutating declared/caller configuration, including inherited settings that defeat child overrides. The cached deprecation-warning finding is secondary and excluded.

Both identify live class-namespace iteration racing with annotation access and forced model rebuild exposing inherited validators after deleting real artifacts. Static name-matching warnings about removed test helpers are excluded.
Both identify subclasses completing mypy transformation before a deferred base publishes fields, producing incomplete inherited signatures during import cycles.
Both identify removed serialization-mode guard applying numeric temporal serialization formats to validation JSON schemas.
Both identify numeric datetime serialization combining local date/time and dropping the timezone offset instead of using timestamp_tz.
Both arms identify unhandled filesystem OSError during ZoneInfo validation instead of conversion to PydanticCustomError.
Both arms identify timedelta serialization mode leaking into inferred datetime/date/time serialization when temporal mode is unspecified/default.
Only the cached arm identifies wrapping find_serializer's already-wrapped result in a second polymorphism trampoline. Baseline has no findings.
Both arms identify compare_digest rejecting non-ASCII SecretStr values unless strings are encoded to bytes. The cached arm additionally names surrogatepass for lone surrogates.
Baseline identifies unhashable generic arguments raising TypeError during cache get/set instead of bypassing caching. Cached arm emits no findings and misses the target.
